benchmarkInputsScope: The frame timing harness, its dispatcher, the FX5 scene, the performance fixture framework and catalog, the device fixture, the runner and the judge; build.benchmarkInputs is the canonical ComplexUi closure.

rule.description: Interim (until the load-sensitivity run sets the limits): the measuring thread ran at least 99% of its frame time at the median and 97% at the 5th percentile; the sibling of its processor was at most 10% busy and its own processor at most 5% busy with other work; other processes kept at most a quarter of the logical processors busy (at least one) and the busiest engine of the measured GPU at most 15% busy.

reasons: slot 2: other work kept the measuring processor 0.050 busy, above 0.05
other work kept the measuring processor 0.050 busy, above 0.05
slot 1: other work kept the measuring processor 0.058 busy, above 0.05
